description: Create a letter of recommendation tracking spreadsheet for graduate school applications. Create a header row with columns: Program Name, Deadline, Recommender 1, Recommender 2, Recommender 3, Materials Sent, Status. Add at least 6 graduate programs with realistic data including program names (e.g., MIT Brain Sciences, Stanford Neuroscience), deadlines (e.g., Dec 1, Dec 15), recommender names (e.g., Dr. Chen, Dr. Park, Dr. Rodriguez), and status information (e.g., 'All submitted', 'Waiting on Chen'). Save the spreadsheet as /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/lor_tracker.xlsx
